structured.answer: If my savings just sit in the עו"ש they earn nothing and lose value to rising prices. The page says 10,000 ₪ is worth about 8,203 ₪ in today's money after 10 years. I won't move anything yet; I'll ask my son and the bank.

stuck.where: Screen 2–3, the calculator 'כמה עולה להשאיר כסף בעו"ש?'
stuck.why: The text says 1,797 ₪ less, then the chart says 'המחיר של להשאיר 2,576 ₪'. I couldn't tell which is my loss.
Suddenly it's 500 ₪ a month, 0%, and 62,681 ₪. I didn't understand where those came from or how they relate to my question.
The first lines are hidden under the row of buttons. I saw dates and BANK-17 but couldn't read the sentence.

findings.what: Two different losses for the same 10,000 ₪ over 10 years (1,797 ₪ in the text, 2,576 ₪ in the chart), with no explanation I could follow
The only alternative offered is 'קרן כספית', which isn't explained in plain words. It's a fund, so I back away
The second calculator jumps to 500 ₪ a month and 0% without saying why. The 62,681 vs 70,000 is confusing
The sticky row of buttons covers the top lines of text, so a sentence with dates was hidden
Black background with pale grey small text (chart legend, notes) is hard to read
Codes like BANK-35 and BANK-15 and the '123 ממקור/מחושב/הזנתם' marks mean nothing to me
A chart with three lines and a brown shaded area. I relied on the sentence, not the chart
Only a slider-looking control for years, though there is a box too
